lead: Asaduddin Owaisi is an Indian politician, born on 13 May 1969 in Hyderabad.
As of 2026, he is 57 years old, and his birth date places him under the Taurus sign.
He has held the office of Member of the 16th Lok Sabha and Member of the 15th Lok Sabha.

sections.heading: Asaduddin Owaisi — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Asaduddin Owaisi was born on 13 May 1969 in Hyderabad, and holds Indian nationality.
Public records name his father, Sultan Salahuddin Owaisi. He is a sibling of Akbaruddin Owaisi.
He received his education at University of London, North-Eastern Hill University, Osmania University and Nizam College.

sections.heading: Asaduddin Owaisi — Career and Professional Work
paras: His professional record lists politician as his main occupation.
He has held the following offices: Member of the 16th Lok Sabha, Member of the 15th Lok Sabha and Member of the 17th Lok Sabha. He is affiliated with All India Majlis-e-Ittehadul Muslimeen.
